The JSON that `seek research <provider> --async --json`, `seek research status --json` and `seek research get --json` print for a resumable research job. It wraps the provider's own response with a provider-qualified locator and a normalized status. `get --json` adds the result when the job has completed.

Definition: [research-job-envelope.schema.json](research-job-envelope.schema.json) (JSON Schema 2020-12).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Accepted values | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator` | object |  | Yes | Identifies the job. The job ID has meaning only together with its provider. |
| `locator.provider` | string | `google`, `parallel`, `perplexity` | Yes | The provider that owns the job. |
| `locator.jobId` | string |  | Yes | The provider's opaque job ID: a Google interaction ID, a Parallel run ID or a Perplexity job ID. |
| `status` | string | `queued`, `running`, `action-required`, `completed`, `incomplete`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `unknown` | Yes | The job's state, normalized across providers. A provider status seek does not map is `unknown`. |
| `providerStatus` | string |  | Yes | The provider's own status string, unchanged. Perplexity statuses map case-insensitively. |
| `terminal` | boolean |  | Yes | Whether the normalized status is final: true for `completed`, `incomplete`, `failed` and `cancelled`. |
| `failure` | object |  | No | The provider's failure report, present when the provider reported one: Google's `error`, Parallel's non-empty `error` or `errors`, or Perplexity's `error_message`. |
| `failure.message` | string |  | No | The provider's failure message, when it gave one. |
| `failure.details` | any |  | No | The provider's failure object, list or message, unchanged. |
| `providerPayload` | any |  | Yes | The provider's complete response to the submission or status request, unchanged. |
| `result` | object |  | No | The report of a completed job, present only in `seek research get --json` output. |
| `result.text` | string |  | Yes | The report text. A Parallel JSON result is serialized with two-space indentation. |
| `result.citations` | array of string |  | Yes | Source URLs in the order seek found them, without duplicates for Google and Parallel. |
| `providerResult` | any |  | No | Parallel's response from its separate result endpoint, unchanged. Present only with `result` for a Parallel job. |

Other fields are rejected.

## Normalized statuses

The job's state, normalized across providers. A provider status seek does not map is `unknown`.

| Status | Terminal | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | No | Accepted and not started. Parallel `queued`; Perplexity `CREATED`. |
| `running` | No | In progress. Google `in_progress`; Parallel `running`, `cancelling`; Perplexity `IN_PROGRESS`. |
| `action-required` | No | Waiting for action by the provider's user before it can continue. Google `requires_action`; Parallel `action_required`. |
| `completed` | Yes | Finished with a result. Terminal. Google `completed`; Parallel `completed`; Perplexity `COMPLETED`. |
| `incomplete` | Yes | Ended before it completed, without a provider failure. Terminal. Google `incomplete`. |
| `failed` | Yes | Ended in a provider failure. Terminal. Google `failed`; Parallel `failed`; Perplexity `FAILED`. |
| `cancelled` | Yes | Cancelled. Terminal. Google `cancelled`; Parallel `cancelled`. |
| `unknown` | No | A provider status seek does not map. Not terminal. |

## Rules

- `terminal` is `true` when `status` is one of `completed`, `incomplete`, `failed`, `cancelled`, and `false` otherwise.
- `providerResult` is present only with `result`.
- With `result`, `status` is `"completed"`.
- With `providerResult`, `locator.provider` is `"parallel"`.
